description: Fleet-shaped control plane on harness guests: three control planes joined with kubeadm join --control-plane behind a kube-vip VIP on the management network. The guest holding the VIP loses power, and the API must answer on the VIP again from the surviving control planes. The guest then boots and rejoins.

checks.description: Three Ready control-plane Nodes each run kube-apiserver and an etcd member, etcd lists three started members, and kubeadm-config names the VIP as controlPlaneEndpoint.
checks.detail: control planes ha-cp1, ha-cp2, ha-cp3 Ready with kube-apiserver and etcd, members ha-cp1, ha-cp2, ha-cp3, endpoint 192.168.140.20:6443

checks.description: The worker gets ok from /livez on the VIP, and every control plane reaches /readyz through its admin.conf, whose server is the VIP.
checks.detail: ha-w1 /livez on 192.168.140.20 ok; /readyz ok from ha-cp1, ha-cp2, ha-cp3 through admin.conf on the VIP

checks.description: The kube-vip lease names one control plane, and only that control plane carries the VIP on its management NIC.
checks.detail: lease plndr-cp-lock held by ha-cp1, VIP 192.168.140.20 on ha-cp1 only

checks.description: After the VIP holder loses power, the worker's /livez probes on the VIP succeed again within the deadline, and the lease and the VIP move to a surviving control plane.
checks.detail: ha-cp1 powered off; 6 of 12 probes failed, API back on 192.168.140.20 after 9.041 s; lease and VIP now on ha-cp2

checks.description: Through the VIP a surviving control plane lists the nodes and writes and deletes a ConfigMap while etcd keeps quorum.
checks.detail: from ha-cp2 through the VIP: nodes listed, ConfigMap written, read and deleted; etcd healthy 2 of 3

checks.description: The powered-off guest boots again, its Node returns Ready, and etcd reports every member healthy.
checks.detail: ha-cp1 Ready again, etcd healthy 3 of 3

checks.description: After the run no process carrying this run id remains on any guest.
checks.detail: ha-cp1: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining; ha-cp2: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining; ha-cp3: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining; ha-w1: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining

security.device_exposure: No test workload runs. kubectl and etcdctl run on the control planes against their admin.conf and etcd client certificates, which never leave the guests. The probe loop on the worker reads only the unauthenticated /livez.
